# TimeDelayedSynapticPlasticity

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The property that synaptic influence is not instantaneous but occurs after a finite delay, affecting the temporal ordering of neural activations. Enables temporal coding and sequence processing in TCC/iNEST, where delay lines and propagation times are fundamental to network topology and computation.
